lines: Well seated in lotus but, by fingertip rays, by suddenly rising rays turned away, by back dwelling.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sūpaviṣṭaḥ padmake tu hastāgrāṅguliraśmibhiḥ parāṅmukhairjhaṭityudyadraśmibhiḥ pṛṣṭhasaṃsthitaiḥ
